 Phoenix Halloween forecast: Will trick-or-treating stay dry? 
 After possible early-morning showers, a 30% chance of rain returns Saturday evening. Sean McLaughlin has the updated Halloween forecast. By Sean McLaughlin Published : Oct. 27, 2026 at 5:42 AM MST | Updated : 17 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google PHOENIX (AZFamily) — Expect highs in the upper 80s this afternoon with a pleasant evening to follow. 
 Lows will fall into the low 60s by early Wednesday morning, with Wednesday and Thursday afternoons warming back into the mid to upper 80s. 
 Rain chances increase Thursday night into Friday morning, with a 40% chance lingering into Friday evening, along with the possibility of an isolated thunderstorm.
 After possible early-morning showers, a 30% chance of rain returns Saturday evening. Still, there should be plenty of dry time for Halloween night, so trick-or-treaters should not fear the forecast at this point.
 Download the First Alert Weather App A stronger system moves in Saturday night into Sunday, bringing a good chance of rain and thunderstorms to the Valley. 
 Some rain could be heavy with localized flooding possible, though uncertainty remains on amounts. 
 Rain chances are highest Sunday morning through mid-afternoon, tapering off by Sunday evening, with drier weather returning Monday. Clouds and rain will cool highs to the mid to upper 70s Friday and Saturday, then to the low 70s Sunday and Monday.
